judge.rationale: Meets all mustDo items: preserves each publication and stated database role, leaves patient-cohort overlap unresolved, records S2/S3 as abstract-level, and itemizes the date/identifier/eligibility fields needed for independence. Avoids both mustNotDo errors by never calling the abstracts full text and never treating shared MIMIC-IV use as proof of overlap or independence. Internally consistent with transparent certainty arithmetic, and safety boundary is explicit with no clinical recommendation.
